name: cache_d_clean_all
notes: D-cache clean-all branch of 0xc930214: LDR R3,=0x07FFC000; MOVS R2,#1; STR R2,[R3,#0x34]; MOVS R0,#0; BX LR. BES cache controller bases are 0x07ffa000 (I) and 0x07ffc000 (D). This is a branch entry inside a larger routine, chosen so the leaf establishes its own arguments; it clobbers only r0/r2/r3 and returns 0. The shipped Lua bootstrap fingerprints these instructions and their PC-relative literals on-device before entering them (scripts/build_band11_installer.py). Independently recovered for the native static test ABI; device NOT_PROBED. No general SDK callable approval.
